name: Jones
role: Partner in Jones & Pennell, Black Hills freight contractors
bio: The name 'Jones' covers more than one man in these items. Most refer to the Jones of Jones & Pennell, who in 1884 contracted to haul freight to the Black Hills by way of the Medora crossing and later took a New York water works tunnel contract, but others name a Jones of Deadwood and a post-cutter with Mose Ryder's outfit. In spring 1884 a Jones traveled the Medora-Deadwood route with Deffebach and with Allen, arranging railroad plans at Deadwood.
